The DB then hit CPU 98% with connections near 500, simple PK lookups became slow, account-svc queries timed out, and edge-proxy returned 504s. This is a cache stampede.
accounts-db connection and CPU saturation, but it only started after the cache was lost.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm the session-cache, or rate-limit and coalesce cache-miss loads with request coalescing/singleflight. Shed load on accounts-db. Turn on RDB/AOF persistence for session-cache so a node replacement doesn't bring it back empty.
